test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'MARS” is coded as “51” and "STARS" is coded as “77”. How will 'MOON' be coded in that language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7fd46426f00ba56b91d423458faa673503496b14e50413ec14eae6a6e84c211.png] The logic followed here is :- Sum of alphabetical positional value of given word. 'MARS” is coded as “51”. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d55832fa80423dccadb7a021bf596384548216d4c6afcb1d7b726b8094e1b541.png] = 13 + 1 + 18 + 19
